qualification.details: Registrar: Master's degree with minimum 55% marks or equivalent. 15 years experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 11 and above or 8 years in Level 12 and above including Associate Professor with educational administration experience OR comparable experience in research establishment OR 15 years administrative experience with 8 years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent. Superintending Engineer: B.Tech./B.E in Civil/Electrical Engineering from recognized Institute/University. Holding analogous position OR 15 years relevant experience in execution and construction of Civil/Electrical Work including Public Health and Contract Management OR 7 years as Executive Engineer in Pay Level-11 or equivalent. Technical Officer: B.Tech./B.E or equivalent in Mechanical/Chemical/Materials Engineering with minimum 60% marks. 6 years relevant experience in Level 6 OR 3 years in Level 7 and above after qualifying degree (M.Tech/M.E or Ph.D duration counted towards experience).

salary_details.details: Registrar: Pay Level 14 Superintending Engineer: Pay Level 13 Technical Officer: Pay Level 10

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Goa Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Goa to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Goa Recruitment 2026 is 02-10-2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: IIT Goa is recruiting for three posts: Registrar, Superintending Engineer, and Technical Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Officer post, a B.Tech./B.E or equivalent in Mechanical/Chemical/Materials Engineering with a minimum of 60% marks is required.

faq.question: Q5. How is the selection process conducted for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Evaluation Process (qualifying) followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per Government of India norms for reserved categories, PwBD, and Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary scale for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: The Registrar post is offered a salary in Pay Level 14 (7th CPC).

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Goa apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions, so candidates from outside Goa may be eligible if they meet the other criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for the Registrar, Superintending Engineer, and Technical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article by clicking on the provided link.
